sentences.text: THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS

Appearance:
 Shri Kamlesh Kumar Dwivedi - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Mohan Sausarkar - Govt. Advocate for the State.

ORDER Petitioner is aggrieved of the order dated 22.08.2024 (Annexure P-1) passed by learned 4th District Judge, Deosar, District Singrauli refusing to entertain the reference made by the petitioner under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the "Act of 2013").
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
It is submitted that, vide Annexure P-3 petitioner had given reference to the Collector on 15.09.2020 and when the Collector failed to take cognizance of that, then in terms of the Second Proviso of Section 64 of the Act of 2013, he had made application to the competent authority requesting it to direct the Collector to make the reference to it within a period of 30 days.
3.

Thus, it is evident that, once Collector failed to take cognizance then, learned District Judge was obliged to call for the report and decide as to whether direction is maintainable or not, but could not have dismissed the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60172 2 WP-38401-2024 application on technical grounds overlooking Annexure P-3.
4.
Therefore, impugned order dated 22.08.2024 (Annexure P-1) having been passed without appreciation of the correct facts on record is set- aside.

6. Accordingly, this petition is disposed off.
